issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Farm.animals: The UML/problem statement specifies a private aggregated attribute '- animals: List<Animal>' and the tasks ask for getter/setter (encapsulation). The solution implementation declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;), while the template currently does not declare the field (left for students to implement). This inconsistency may confuse students about the intended encapsulation: whether they should implement a private field with getter/setter (as described) or a public field (as in the solution).
issues.suggestedFix: Make Farm.animals private to match the UML/specification: declare 'private List<Animal> animals;' and keep or add public getter and setter methods. Update any direct field accesses in the solution to use the getter/setter. Ensure the template and solution both reflect the private field with public getAnimals()/setAnimals(...) to avoid encouraging direct public access.
